items.resolution: Partial-fill, cancel, replace, ambiguity and restart lifecycle certified with cancel-first fresh-risk replace semantics.
Strict versioned machine-readable registry, explicit runtime serializers, compatibility policy and CI gate.
Exact-boundary/+epsilon capital-limit matrix plus durable reservation-capacity and cross-process reservation-race tests are certified.
Durable UTC-session loss/drawdown telemetry atomically activates persistent circuit state; recovery requires explicit acknowledgement.
Critical R2 failure paths have targeted adversarial tests and the repository enforces branch coverage with an 85% minimum gate.
Startup reconciliation repairs terminal OMS/fill commit that crashed before portfolio projection/reservation release, exactly once.
Safety input validates finite values plus exact gross/net and per-strategy gross consistency against position maps.
Both durable and in-memory portfolio projection bind fill_id to immutable fill content; conflicting reuse fails closed.
ORDER_REPLACE_REQUESTED/REPLACE_PENDING is durable and retry-safe across crash between cancel and replacement submission, with conflicting replacement identity failing closed.
Core/knowledge workflows moved to Node-24-generation official actions (checkout@v5, setup-python@v6).

items.next_action: Generate a real semantic/deep graph from a supported coding assistant when that runtime is available; never fake graphify-out artifacts.

items.resolution: Deny-by-default GET-only HTTPS exact-host/path public-data boundary is bounded by timeout, response size and range, validates redirect targets before redirected I/O, and exposes no private/trading endpoint authority.

External klines are converted into the certified R1 MarketDataset contract with exact half-open coverage, no silent imputation, source/dataset/manifest hashes, tamper detection and verified artifact roundtrip.
Durable frozen campaign universes require preregistration before evaluation and immutable terminal accounting for every registered trial.
FINAL_HOLDOUT trials require one-use consumed final_validation permits bound one-to-one to a trial; CI statically forbids research imports/symbols that would create execution authority.

Holm evidence is computed over the complete frozen trial family; PBO/CSCV and Deflated Sharpe require explicit statistical preconditions and fail closed when the trial universe/evidence is incomplete.

An explicit opt-in 10-bar BTCUSDT public-data campaign performed two independent read-only fetches with equal source/dataset/manifest hashes and verified artifact roundtrip; no API keys, trading endpoints or execution authority were used. This is intake/reproducibility evidence, not profitability evidence.
Research Control Center is a read-only projection over immutable research evidence and remains outside OMS/broker/capital authority by construction and CI policy.

Strategy Tournament deterministically ranks the complete frozen DEVELOPMENT universe, includes failed trials, uses explicit metric direction and immutable identity tie-breaking, rejects HOLDOUT-containing campaigns/cherry-picked candidate sets, binds evidence to terminal result hashes and exposes no execution or promotion authority.

Versioned append-only authoritative venue-rule master is structurally separate from research metadata; canonical identities, tick/step/min-max rules, status, provenance, staleness and dual persisted/embedded fingerprint integrity are fail-closed and machine-contract validated.

items.next_action: Implement canonical strategy return/exposure evidence, dependence/correlation estimates, diversification constraints and cross-strategy/cluster budgets using authorized TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT data only; insufficient evidence must not increase risk.

Implement deterministic allocation perturbation and leave-one-strategy/component-out robustness evidence tied to immutable strategy/dataset/config fingerprints; fragile point optima must fail robustness gates.

Implement versioned regime features/models calibrated only on TRAIN/authorized development evidence, structurally prohibit HOLDOUT-derived threshold recalibration and treat missing/stale regime state conservatively.
Implement immutable health baselines, deterministic drift evidence, explicit health-state transitions and auditable quarantine/retirement criteria with idempotent replay.

Implement a durable bridge whose automatic actions can only reduce/block/quarantine risk, with stricter-state-wins concurrency and explicit acknowledgement/fresh-evidence recovery; it must never increase exposure or bypass Safety Kernel/OMS.

Implement deterministic bounded candidate sizing/weights with strategy, correlated-cluster and portfolio budgets. Output remains advisory/control-plane input and cannot submit broker orders or bypass Capital Safety Kernel/OMS.

items.resolution: Existing R0/R2 versioned Portfolio State, reconciliation and reservation infrastructure was audited and hardened for R4: persistence and Safety share one semantic snapshot validator; in-memory stores detach nested mappings, validate CAS/reconciliation writes, and publish fill batches atomically; durable state integrity is covered by the companion R4 fill/portfolio commitments.

Every durable fill read/replay now verifies canonical payload against fill_hash plus independent fill_id/order_id/occurred_at columns; malformed, rehashed-conflicting or corrupted rows fail closed before OMS or portfolio projection can consume them.

portfolio_state now carries an independent SHA-256 commitment over exact canonical snapshot bytes; every read/write/CAS/reservation validates hash and shared semantic integrity, with conservative legacy migration that refuses to bless invalid prior rows.
